faq.a: Zara is associated with the Arabic form زَارَا, whose core sense is zara; blossom, flower.

faq.q: What is the origin of Zara?
faq.a: Zara is associated with Arabic. Zara is a short form of Arabic زَهْرَة (Zahra), meaning 'blossom, flower'.
Yes — the underlying form زَارَا is Arabic.
Zara can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Zara should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Zahra is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Zara mean in Persian?

faq.a: Romanization variants include Zara, zara. Script forms are زارا, زَارَا, ज़ारा.

faq.q: Is Zara a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
